text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It seems she was swallowed by the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What is happening...
My running... what is happening to me...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I know full well
that rushing won't help.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me.
I showed you an unsightly side of myself."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
...What do you call it, that thing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you again starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If it's about bitter disappointment,
I've experienced it plenty of times up to now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My race tactician.
Tell me our next move.
